notes: Updates no longer hang: the app window is closed for the install and reopened after, and a failed update now says why. HACCP log keeps readings taken at earlier log times. Settings - Logs shows the app and update logs. A calibration test that is left running shows on the Dashboard and stops after 30 minutes. Units - Move this unit to another probe. A reply to an alert email acknowledges the alert and stops its reminders; managers are asked to record the corrective action, which is printed on the HACCP log.
